fixes.explanation: The great deep and the heavens. Verse 11 says, “…all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.” That's water from below and water from above. Then the waters keep rising until they cover the mountaintops (Genesis 7:19, 20).

Idols! I see you swinging, baker, and I respect it. Idols do show up in other places, like Exodus 20:4, but this verse never says the word. It says, “…the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and full of violence.” I've guessed with a lot of confidence and zero evidence before, so no shame here. Violence is the one that fits.

Names? Baker, nobody is handing out name tags at the ark door. God says the seven pairs of birds are there “…to preserve their offspring on the face of all the earth.” Offspring means the young ones that come after. That's the word that fills the blank, friend.
